name: sim-tools-ns3
description: Protocol-agnostic ns-3 comparison tooling. Its ns-3 package (vcpkg port sim-tools-ns3) is the routing-bench module: the harness every protocol arm registers with, the stock aodv, olsr, dsdv and hwmp arms, and the routing-compare program. Its Python package (swarm-sim-tools) reads the marker lines: the ns3-tool CLI and the ns3-campaign driver.
